note:
R58 — PS4 `0XTC` (little-endian `CTX0`, 64-bit pointers) context records decoded by pointer walk; NHL 20 / 21 = file version 4,
NHL 15–19 = version 3 (parsed where the same layout holds; refused otherwise). Read-only over the extracted trees; nothing game-verified.

File:   '0XTCTTEK' | u32 version | u32 n | u32 A | u32 n | zeros | u64 pool1 ptr @0x30 (condition names) | u64 pool2 ptr @0x38 (trigger names)
        | 0x50: A x 16 bytes (u32 k, zeros) group table | n x u64 record pointers (unsorted) | T2 / T3 rows (n x (u64 1, u64 ptr) …) | records | pool1 | pool2
Record (0x58-byte header, all little-endian):
        +00 u32 context id | +04 u32 w1 (priority-like) | +08 u8 ncond, u8 nextra, u8 nblk, u8 100 | +0c u32 0 | +10 u16 time-like, u16 kind | +14 u32 0
        +18 u64 0 | +20 u64 trigger-name offset in pool2 (ff = no trigger) | +28 u64 item slot 0 | +30 u64 item slot 1 | +38 u64 block-table ptr (nblk x 16 B)
        +40 u64 condition-list ptr (ff when ncond = 0) | +48 u64 extra ptr (ff when nextra = 0) | +50 u64 context-name ptr
Item:   u64 0 | u32 ref (u16 namespace, u16 event id) | u32 0 | u64 0 x3 | u64 name ptr | u64 nparam | nparam x (u64 kind, u64 ptr)   (fixed part 56 B)
        kind 1 -> ptr -> u32 immediate; kind 2 -> ptr -> call block `u64 0 | u32 blob, u32 nargs | (nargs == 0 ? u64 ff : u64 0) | nargs x (u64 1, u64 ptr -> u32)`
Condition (list = ncond x u64 ptr): u32 nargs | u32 blob | u64 args ptr (ff when nargs = 0; -> nargs x u32) | u64 name offset in pool1
Block table entry (nblk): u8 a | u8 b | u16 0 | u32 v | u64 w — NOT decoded (the PS4 form of Legacy's slot-w11 block), recorded raw.
Checks: trigger offsets resolve to pool2 string starts; item refs resolve in the speech MOIR (LE: entries at 0x40, stride 24, u64 ptr @+8,
u64 id @+16) by id AND inline name; condition names resolve in pool1; blob indices <= .gas (CSIS, LE) blob count; nblk table well-formed.
Usage: python r58_ps4_ctx0_records.py <out.json> [--titles nhl21,nhl20]
